title: Play this board game with Mini games for free on any device
author: goektasgaming
selftext:
It's a heavy mario party inspired board game for Android and Web. You can play the demo here for free

https://goektasgaming.com/crossparty/play/

Trailer https://youtu.be/Lh4XboJP\_9o

about the game  

it's a silly up to 4 Player board game with mii-style characters, 8 board, 42 mini games and so much more  

  

i have started with claude.ai fiddling around and thought, come on, Nintendo isn't giving us the well deserved online Mario Party game. So i started prompting my ideas. After maannnnyyx iterations. I think 400+??? i have a build that can be shared with others - or so, i hope.   

  

Let me know what you guys think  

Happy gaming  

goektasgaming
